gate: Su public Zenodo release file inventory
permitted_operations: record file names, sizes, checksums and download URLs
verify advertised checksum when MD5 is supplied
inspect ZIP central-directory member names/sizes/CRC only without reading member payloads

select a data file based on observed values
construct chi_bio, Chi_bio, or Bio Chi
